name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-pre-release-fire-hammer-sledge-bros
title: Super Mario World (Pre-release) - Fire / Hammer / Sledge Bros.
description:
The hammer brothers and sledge brothers from super mario world's prototype, now edited to be used in your hack!

To be used with the next sprites:

fire bro

hammer bro

boomerang bro

sledge bro

-------------------------------------------------------------
note that to use the fire bro correctly, you have to find this line in the original ASM file:

.tilemap
db $A2,$A0,$A2,$E6,$A6,$A4

-------------------------------------------------------------
and change it to:
-------------------------------------------------------------

.tilemap
db $A6,$A0,$A6,$E6,$A6,$A4
-------------------------------------------------------------
